summary: Phase 2 (Dress Me + Suggested/Saved/Worn distinction) verified end-to-end — 100% pass across 12 pytest cases and 15 UI assertions on the reviewer account (review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable>) at 390x844. BACKEND (pytest, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration45_phase2_dressme.py — 12/12 passed in 38.9s): POST /api/wear persists the new `name` field, returns it in the response, and increments wear_count + sets last_worn for every item in item_ids (verified pre/post via GET /api/items/{id}); GET /api/wear/{log_id} returns 200 with resolved slim `items` (photo thumbs, no orig_photo), 404 for unknown ids; GET /api/wear/pending?date=2020-01-01 is NOT shadowed by /wear/{log_id} — returns 200 with {"pending":false}; POST /api/outfits/mix accepts item_ids, wear_log_id and outfit_id independently, echoes mixed_from_item_ids and occasion_used, returns resolved_items with necessity ∈ {core,recommended,optional,""}, and demonstrably KEEPS THE MAJORITY of the base pieces (overlap ≥ 50% of selected against the passed base of 4 items); POST /api/outfits/mix with no source returns 400; POST /api/dressme with an explicit occasion ("job interview at a design studio", 15°C cloudy) generates a look with resolved_items; GET /api/dressme/context returns {has_context, source, label}; POST /api/outfits with source='ai' saves + GET /api/outfits returns the outfit with slim item thumbnails (no orig_photo); crucially, POST /api/dressme (a suggestion) does NOT create any /api/outfits or /api/wear records — counts before == counts after. FRONTEND (Playwright, 390x844, Expo Web preview through EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): Home has home-collections + home-collections-saved + home-collections-worn pills; Dress Me (/dressme) opens on the ask phase with 'What am I dressing you for?', a multiline dressme-request-input, all 8 shortcut chips (dressme-shortcut-Job interview etc.), and a dressme-request-go that is aria-disabled=true when the input is empty; tapping the Job interview chip fills the input with 'Job interview' (does NOT auto-generate); typing 'Work' then Style me for this routes to dressme-followup with dressme-followup-input, dressme-followup-go and dressme-followup-skip; Skip — just style me triggers generation and after ~20-40s the result panel shows exactly the four action testIDs dressme-wear-today, dressme-save-later, dressme-again, dressme-discard; typing a rich request ('Office all day, then drinks after work') skips the follow-up and goes straight to generation; Save for later shows dressme-outcome-saved with 'Saved for later.' confirmation and a 'View in Saved' link. My Collections (/collections) is exactly two destinations — Saved (1 outfit) and Worn (0 wears → then 1 after test) — both navigate to /saved and /worn. Saved outfit detail (/outfit/{id}) exposes outfit-wear-today which records a wear, and the outfit REMAINS in Saved (count 2 → 2 after wear); the wear now appears at /worn (1 entry) and its detail (/worn/{log_id}) exposes worn-wear-again + worn-mix-up. worn-mix-up correctly navigates to /dressme?mix=<log_id>, and the mix generation returns a look with the same four actions. Tab bar visible and unobstructed in every screen at 390x844, no clipping. Only pre-existing harmless RN-Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents) and one benign storage(parse) warning from an earlier localStorage seeding attempt (production login path is unaffected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2214-2243 POST /api/outfits/mix resolves base pieces from item_ids > wear_log_id > outfit_id, calls await enforce_limit(user, 'dressme') (correctly counts against the free monthly Dress Me cap per the spec), passes base_item_ids into _build_outfit which emits the REFRESH prompt line at 2076-2090 to keep hero pieces and change only 1-2 — verified at runtime with a 4-item base returning majority overlap.

server.py:3238-3250 GET /api/wear/{log_id} is registered AFTER GET /api/wear/pending (3154) and GET /api/wear (3224), so FastAPI's ordered matching serves the static routes first — confirmed by asserting /api/wear/pending?date=... returns 200 with {"pending": ...} and not the log-not-found 404.

server.py:3128-3145 POST /api/wear now stores the `name` field (from WearLog:1249) alongside item_ids, increments wear_count and sets last_worn for every listed item, and pops _id before returning — verified via GET on the created log and via item wear_count deltas.

server.py:2169-2200 POST /api/dressme returns the generated outfit but never writes to db.outfits or db.wear_logs — only record_style_suggestion (which is a separate log for rotation) is touched. Confirmed: outfit/wear list counts unchanged after generation.

app/(tabs)/dressme.tsx:183-202 submitRequest routes >3-word / non-broad phrases straight to generate() and only shows the follow-up card for the six broad regexes at 32-39; submitFollowup joins the base request with the extra when not skipped. dressme-request-go's disabled state (361) is driven by !request.trim(), matching the spec.

app/(tabs)/dressme.tsx:243-249 discard() sets phase back to 'ask' and clears result/outcome but leaves the `request` text in place; nothing is persisted to /api/outfits or /api/wear (confirmed at runtime). Minor UX note (not a bug): if the reviewer prefers the box also cleared on Discard, mirror startOver()'s setRequest('') — currently intentional per the two distinct functions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every Phase-2 UI assertion passed at 390x844: home collections/pills, dressme ask/followup/result phases, all four dressme-outcome actions, saved outfit detail wear-today with saved-stays-saved, worn list + detail, worn-mix-up → /dressme?mix=<id> generation, no clipping and tab bar unobstructed.

Tests create + delete their own TEST_-prefixed outfits; one TEST_ named wear log remains in the reviewer's history (harmless, name TEST_phase2_named_wear / TEST_mix_source).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend AI limits: `db.users.updateOne({user_id:'user_testaura01'},{$set:{premium_until:'2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'}})` — already applied. UI login via review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable> on /login (testIDs: login-email, login-password, email-submit). Phase 2 testIDs to rely on: dressme-ask/dressme-request-input/dressme-request-go, dressme-shortcut-<label>, dressme-followup/dressme-followup-input/dressme-followup-go/dressme-followup-skip, dressme-wear-today/dressme-save-later/dressme-again/dressme-discard, dressme-outcome-worn/dressme-outcome-saved, collections-saved/collections-worn, saved-outfit-<id>, worn-log-<id>, outfit-wear-today, worn-wear-again, worn-mix-up. Mix flow uses /dressme?mix=<wear_log_id> and consumes the dressme monthly quota — grant premium to keep tests deterministic. discard() intentionally does not clear the text box (only startOver does); both restore the ask phase and neither writes anything to the DB. Pre-existing harmless RN-Web warnings still present ('shadow*', 'props.pointerEvents').
rca_of_issue: N/A — full Phase 2 verification pass, no regressions detected. Suggested/Saved/Worn distinction is enforced by construction: /api/dressme never touches db.outfits/db.wear_logs, /api/outfits (source='ai') is the only Save path, /api/wear is the only Worn path, /api/outfits/mix rebuilds only 1-2 pieces via the REFRESH prompt line while echoing mixed_from_item_ids/occasion_used, and /api/wear/{log_id} is safely ordered after /api/wear/pending.
